_note: Review feed for Vantro (fictional). EVERY review here is source 'seed': written for design demos, not real player reviews. A config that uses seed reviews builds only with "demo": true and shows a sample-content banner on every page (brief 07, section 2). Real reviews use source 'site-form' or 'import' and status pending/published/rejected.

reviews.name: Jack T.
reviews.title: PayID withdrawal in minutes
reviews.text: Withdrew after the Saturday games and it landed in my account before I'd finished my coffee. The tracker shows every step, which is a nice touch.

reviews.name: Sophie W.
reviews.title: Stuck on ID check for a week
reviews.text: My licence was rejected twice because the address didn't match an old Medicare card. Support were polite but I couldn't withdraw until it was sorted.

reply.text: Sophie, sorry for the wait. When two documents show different addresses we have to confirm the current one. Your account is now verified and withdrawals are open.

reviews.name: Liam O.
reviews.title: Best same-game multi builder I've used
reviews.text: Building a netball SGM from the live screen is quick. Prices update without kicking me out of the bet slip.

reviews.name: Chloe M.
reviews.title: Smooth app, heavy download
reviews.text: Runs well on my iPhone but it's a big app. Face ID log-in works every time.

reviews.name: Noah K.
reviews.title: AFL prices are fine, racing less so
reviews.text: Footy markets are competitive. For racing I usually find a slightly better price elsewhere.

reviews.name: Emily R.
reviews.title: Set my deposit limit for me
reviews.text: Asked how to set a weekly limit and the chat agent walked me through it in under two minutes. No upselling.

reviews.name: Oliver B.
reviews.title: Withdrawal reversed with no reason
reviews.text: My bank transfer was cancelled and the money went back to my balance. Took two chats to find out my BSB had a typo. A clear message would have saved a day.

reply.text: Oliver, fair point. The cancellation screen now says why a transfer was returned. PayID avoids this, as the name on the account is checked first.

reviews.name: Mia H.
reviews.title: PayID deposits are instant
reviews.text: Money shows up straight away. Debit card works too. Glad there's no credit card option, honestly.

reviews.name: Ethan P.
reviews.title: Consistently quick
reviews.text: Ten or so withdrawals now, all PayID, all under an hour.

reviews.name: Grace L.
reviews.title: Live stats are great, notifications not
reviews.text: Love the live stats during the footy. Turned off the push notifications though, too many.

reviews.name: Harrison D.
reviews.title: Verification sorted over chat
reviews.text: Didn't know which document to upload. The agent told me exactly what was needed and I was approved the same afternoon.

reviews.name: Zoe F.
reviews.title: Market suspended at the worst time
reviews.text: Cash out was unavailable for a few minutes near the end of a close game. Understand why, but frustrating.

reply.text: Zoe, markets pause briefly after big moments in play so prices stay fair. We're working to shorten those pauses.

reviews.name: Lucas G.
reviews.title: Tracker is genuinely useful
reviews.text: Seeing the withdrawal status live stops me refreshing my banking app every five minutes.

reviews.name: Ava N.
reviews.title: Good range of netball markets
reviews.text: Hard to find decent netball markets elsewhere. Vantro has player and quarter markets most weeks.

reviews.name: Cooper J.
reviews.title: Helpful, a bit slow on weekends
reviews.text: Got a good answer, but waited about eight minutes on a Saturday arvo.

reviews.name: Isla S.
reviews.title: No fees either way
reviews.text: Haven't been charged anything for deposits or withdrawals.

reviews.name: Mason C.
reviews.title: App crashed during the final
reviews.text: Kept closing during the grand final rush. Had to use the website instead.

reply.text: Mason, we had a spike in traffic that night. Version 5.12 includes fixes for older phones. Sorry it let you down.

reviews.name: Ruby E.
reviews.title: Quick sign-up
reviews.text: Driver licence check went through automatically in a couple of minutes.

reviews.name: William Y.
reviews.title: Easy to use on the go
reviews.text: Clean layout, finding a match takes two taps.

reviews.name: Ella V.
reviews.title: Email support is slow
reviews.text: Chat is good, but my email took nearly two days to get a reply.

reviews.name: Henry A.
reviews.title: Fast and no fuss
reviews.text: Withdrawals just work. That's all I want.

reviews.name: Charlotte X.
reviews.title: Activity statement on request
reviews.text: Asked for my activity statement for the year and got it the same day.

reviews.name: Jacob Z.
reviews.title: Bank transfer took three days
reviews.text: PayID is quick but my bank transfer over a long weekend took ages. Use PayID if you can.

reviews.name: Amelia U.
reviews.title: Limits easy to find
reviews.text: Deposit limits and BetStop info are right there in the account menu, not hidden away.
